description: A panel: one of Baude's things drawn as a live widget (real, usable, as in a window) on a flat face, px by px, the face size metres wide and high.

show.description: What's drawn: a chat (its page, the transcript and its box), a chat's row (as the sidebar has it), a host (its name, state and chats), a Meta card, or a whole window as it is.

of.description: Which thing: its id (a chat's host/session, a host's id), or first: the first slot's thing. Left out in slots.
